finalists.label: Infundibulocystic Basal Cell Carcinoma
finalists.why: It has specific histopathological evidence of buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces and clefting between tumor aggregates and the surrounding stroma.

finalists.label: Trichoepithelioma
finalists.why: It has evidence of multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored asymptomatic papules and histopathological features of buds and cords of basaloid cells, but lacks specific genetic evidence found in the vignette.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has specific histopathological evidence and genetic testing revealing a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene, which is more decisive than the runner-up's evidence.
